name: Liang
source:
[spoiler]She has superhuman memory, yet she is plagued with memory loss from time to time. She was raised by the terrorist leader, Qu Wong. She is quite good with martial arts. 
One of the three testing subjects in the early developments of the brain-washing chip, she was the victim of experiments relating to memory manipulation.[/spoiler]
